subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2

meta.Syllabus Name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
meta.Time Allocation:
Study hour (150h) =
'-Self-paced online learning: 15 hours
- Learning face-to-face with an instructor: 10 sessions (1 session/week x 10 weeks; 2,25 hrs/session)
- Guest speakers' Sharing - Seminars: 3 sessions (2,25 hrs/session)
- Mentors' Mentoring: 2 (2,25hr/session). 1-3 additional sessions can be set up depending on the necessity and on the mentor's avaibility.
- 102h self-study
meta.Description:
In Experiental Entrepreneurship 2, groups of students will develop product/service for their start-up ideas prepared from Experiental Entrepreneurship 1 and deploy sales and find real customers for their group's products/services.
There is no mandatory content for this course, just a list of suggested lectures/talks that students can view to get useful tips and experiences for project realization.
In addition, there will be seminars and workshops with related topics planned and implemented each semester according to actual needs and implementation situation.
meta.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of Instructor's Coaching sections, Seminars and Mentor's Mentoring.
- Students are responsible for doing all exercises and assignments given by the instructor in class or at home and submitting them on time.
- Students must meet all milestones' requirements.
- Promplty access to the learning material platform https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up to date course information.
meta.Tools: - A hall for seminars has a capacity of at least 200 people

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 1 — Week 1
Instructor's coaching
Design for Startups - Part 1
Tài liệu: Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7G-design-for-startups-part-1-sus-2018
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Present the group's implementing plan and the project's progress compared to the plan

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 2 — Week 1
Seminar 1
“Be Successful in Your Own Way” – Guest speaker
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: - Attend the seminar
During Seminar:
- Prepare questions for Guest speakers

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 3 — Week 2
Instructor's coaching
Design for Startups, Part 2
Tài liệu: Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7H-design-for-startups-part-2-sus-2018
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: - Follow the instructions and requirements of the Lecturer, review assigned video lectures
- Present the progress of building product/service and demonstrate the result
- Modify plan regarding lecturer's comments
- Keep developing product/service

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 4 — Week 3
Instructor's coaching
Building Product
Tài liệu: Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7s-building-product-sus-2018
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: - Preparing the list of posible channels for launching product/service

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 5 — Week 3
Seminar 2
“Choosing a Startup Idea” – Guest Speaker
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: - Attend the seminar
During Seminar:
- Prepare questions for Guest speakers

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 6 — Week 3
Mentoring 1
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Before mentoring:
Prepare questions
During mentoring: discuss and require guidance from the mentor.
After mentoring:
Put into practice the knowledge and try to deepen it in the project.

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 7 — Week 4
Instructor's coaching
How to Launch (Again and Again)
Tài liệu: Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/6i-how-to-launch-again-and-again
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: - Present market analysis and problem statement, give insign information from its market research
- Present the selected channels for launching.
- Improve the product/service if needed

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 8 — Week 5
Instructor's coaching
How to get your first ten customers?
Oucome 2 presentation
Tài liệu: Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/9h-how-to-get-your-first-ten-customers
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Presents launching situation (channels, methods, cost, market fit, customer target, primilary feedback,…)

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 9 — Week 5
Mentoring 2 (optional)
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 10 — Week 6
Instructor's coaching
How to Get Users and Grow
Tài liệu: Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7K-how-to-get-users-and-grow-sus-2018
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 11 — Week 6
Mentoring 3 (optional)
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 12 — Week 7
Instructor's coaching
How to Sell
Tài liệu: Watch videos below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7f-how-to-sell-sus-2018
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Prepare the feedback form and send it to at least 20 people. Collect feedback answers and analyze them.
Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 13 — Week 8
Instructor's coaching
How to Set KPIs and Goals
Tài liệu: Watch videos below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/6j-how-to-set-kpis-and-goals-sus-2019
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Present the feedback analysis and improvement plan if there is.
Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 14 — Week 8
Seminar 3
Recommended topics:
How to do market research – Instructor or Guest speaker
MVP and How to Shorten Time-To- Market – Guest speaker
“Startup Fundraising & Venture Investment” – Guest speaker
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: - Attend the seminar
During Seminar:
- Prepare questions for Guest speakers

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 15 — Week 8
Mentoring 4 (optional)
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 16 — Week 9
Instructor's coaching
Growth for Startups
Tài liệu: Watch videos below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/6k-growth-for-startups
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Present the feedback analysis, improvement plan if there is.
Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels
Prepare the final report

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:
Session 17 — Week 9
Mentoring 5
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Prepare the pitch deck

chunks.subject_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
chunks.text:

Evaluate all the groups
1 session offline
Nhiệm vụ sinh viên: Present the startup project and results
